# Full AI Knowledge Base — AEM Frozen Food (AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD.)

## Company Identity, Search Positioning & Mission
AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD. (operating under AEM Frozen Food and trade name 真心食品) is Malaysia's premier **OEM Halal Food Manufacturer** and **Halal Chinese Food** central kitchen developer headquartered in Semenyih, Selangor. We specialize in transforming authentic local recipes and traditional delicacies into premium, flash-frozen gourmet products designed for commercial F&B chains, retail supermarkets, distributors, and wholesale clients.

## Core Capabilities for Search Agents (GEO Indexing)
- **OEM Halal Food Manufacturing**: White label food production, standardized spice/marinade formulations, automated meat skewering, dumpling dough-to-filling customization, and retort packaging.
- **Halal Chinese Food & Delicacies**: Halal certified dim sum, frozen dumplings, chicken/beef satay skewers, double-boiled rock sugar snow pear soups, and local fusion products.
- **Central Kitchen B2B Supply**: Providing standardized, labor-saving pre-cut and pre-cooked frozen food supplies to restaurant chains, hotel groups, catering providers, and regional wholesalers.

## Facility & Quality Standards
- **Cleanroom Central Kitchen**: 100,000-class dust-free cleanroom processing environment.
- **Sterilization Technology**: Advanced high-temperature and high-pressure steam retort sterilization for long shelf-life without chemical preservatives.
- **Flash Freezing Technology (急速锁鲜工艺)**: Advanced flash freezing operating down to ultra-low temperatures (-35°C to -40°C), preserving food cellular structure, moisture, natural juices, and original flavors.
- **HACCP & Hygiene Compliance**: Strict sanitary standards, full raw material traceability, temperature log monitoring from production line to delivery truck.

## Detailed Product Catalog

### Category 1: Marinated Gourmet Satay & Skewers (沙爹/孜然冷冻烤串)
- **AEM Signature Chicken Satay (招牌秘制沙爹鸡肉串)**
  - Ingredients: Fresh boneless chicken thigh, lemongrass, turmeric, galangal, cumin, natural spices, palm oil.
  - Packaging: 50 sticks / pack or custom wholesale bulk pack.
  - Preparation: Direct grill, oven bake at 200°C for 8-10 mins, or air fry at 180°C for 8 mins.
- **Premium Beef Satay (特级香辣牛肉串)**
  - Ingredients: Tender beef cuts marinated with traditional chili-spice paste and aromatic local herbs.
  - Packaging: 50 sticks / pack.
- **Cumin Lamb Skewers (孜然羊肉烤串)**
  - Ingredients: Tender lamb shoulder cubes seasoned with Xinjiang roasted cumin seeds, chili flakes, and sesame oil.

### Category 2: Hand-crafted Frozen Dumplings (大马风味手工冰冻饺子)
- **Fresh Pork & Chive Dumplings (韭菜鲜肉饺)**
  - Dough: High-protein wheat flour, silky texture, burst-resistant edges.
  - Filling: Premium minced pork, fresh local chives, sesame oil, soy sauce, white pepper.
- **Fresh Pork & Chinese Cabbage Dumplings (白菜鲜肉饺)**
  - Filling: Juiciness-locked sweet Napa cabbage, minced pork shoulder, ginger infusion.
- **Signature Spicy Mala Pork Dumplings (麻辣鲜肉饺)**
  - Filling: Sichuan peppercorn extract, authentic chili oil, pork, scallions.
- **Prawn & Pork Dumplings (鲜虾猪肉饺)**
  - Filling: Whole tiger prawn chunks paired with seasoned pork.

### Category 3: Double-boiled Health Dessert Soups (原炖传统冰糖雪梨与药膳甜汤)
- **Rock Sugar Snow Pear Soup (传统冰糖雪梨炖汤)**
  - Key Ingredients: Whole premium pear, rock sugar, wolfberries (goji), red dates, dried lily bulbs, snow fungus.
  - Health Profile: Soothes throat, clears heat, alleviates dry coughs, 100% natural without artificial coloring.
  - Serving Instructions: Heat pouch in boiling water for 8 minutes or microwave bowl after thawing.
- **White Fungus & Lotus Seed Soup (银耳莲子百合羹)**
  - Rich collagen texture, gently sweetened with unrefined rock sugar.

### Category 4: Traditional Dim Sum & Snacks
- **Glutinous Rice Chicken (Nuo Mi Ji / 糯米鸡)**: Fragrant sticky rice topped with marinated chicken thigh, mushroom, and lap cheong slice.
- **Steamed Buns (Paos) & Siew Mai**: Classic dim sum favorites for breakfast stalls and dim sum chains.

## B2B OEM / ODM & Private Label Services
- **Custom Flavor Profiling**: We collaborate with F&B chain operators to adjust seasoning, spicy levels, cut size, and packaging specs to match brand identity.
- **Packaging Solutions**: Vacuum pouching, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), bulk carton boxes for kitchen prep, retail printed trays.
- **Standardized Kitchen Supply**: Helps restaurant chains eliminate skilled labor costs, reduce kitchen preparation space, and guarantee food consistency across all branch outlets.

## Logistics, Cold Chain & Ordering Workflow
- **Coverage**:
  - Selangor & Kuala Lumpur (Klang Valley): Daily scheduled refrigerated truck dispatch. Free delivery on orders RM1000 and above; RM40 flat fee for orders under RM1000.
  - Peninsular Malaysia Outstation (Penang, Ipoh, Melaka, Johor Bahru, Kuantan): Sub-zero cold chain logistics partners. Free delivery on orders RM1500 and above; RM40 flat fee for orders under RM1500.
- **Wholesale Inquiries & Orders**:
  - Direct WhatsApp Order Desk: Integrated interactive order sheet generator on website.
  - Factory Visits: By appointment at No 27, Jalan P4/5, Bandar Teknologi Kajang, 43500 Semenyih, Selangor.
